lastCompletedStory.title: Reviewer gate-fail is a hard-constraint FAIL producing FIXES_PENDING

nextStoryContext: US-005 integrated behavioral-gate FAIL as a hard-constraint into the existing hard-constraint rule in both .claude/agents/subagent-reviewer.md and templates/agents/subagent-reviewer.md. The new bullet reads: 'A behavioral gate FAIL at Layer B: one or more tmux-drivable oracle directives in the story's acceptanceCriteria failed during the reviewer's independent re-run. Report each failed oracle as a CRITICAL finding in review-report.json and emit FIXES_PENDING:N. This hard-constraint is integrated into the 8-criteria findings channel; it does NOT introduce a separate verdict field or a parallel gate-verdict path.' No changes to review.ts were needed: the existing makeReviewDispatch already routes file-based CRITICAL findings through buildFixStories -> FIXES_PENDING:N. 5 new tests were added to test/supervisor/review.test.ts (describe block 'makeReviewDispatch: behavioral gate FAIL as hard-constraint (US-005)'). file-size budget raised from 1220->1425 for test/supervisor/review.test.ts (CAM-116 US-005 ref). Vendor was re-embedded. The file-assert oracle 'grep -qi behavioral gate .claude/agents/subagent-reviewer.md' passes.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Story only edited agent prompt .md files, added unit tests to test/supervisor/review.test.ts, updated file-size-budget.json, and re-embedded vendor. No external library was exercised.
